normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents…“HP 315 Condo” at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach! Wake up to breathtaking ocean views, soak up the sun by the lagoon-style pool, and embrace laid-back luxury in a newly renovated space designed for unforgettable getaways. Steps from Rosemary Beach and vibrant local spots, this is where relaxation meets adventure. Perfect for families or friends looking to escape the ordinary. Seasonal beach chair service included—paradise is calling! Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Stunning Pool Views from the Main Balcony – Wake up to breathtaking views of a serene resort pool, setting the perfect tone for a relaxing getaway.Just Steps to Dining, Shopping, and Iconic Rosemary Beach – Enjoy the ultimate convenience of having charming boutiques, delicious eateries, and the beauty of Rosemary Beach right at your doorstep.Newly Renovated, Bright, and Open Living Spaces – Experience modern coastal elegance with spacious, stylish interiors designed for comfort and connection.Seasonal Beach Chair Service Included – Relax effortlessly with complimentary beach chair service, making your sun-soaked days even more enjoyable.Onsite Beachfront Bar and Grill - Crabby Steve’s – Savor laid-back vibes and oceanfront dining at this hidden gem, just steps from the sand.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"The condo was absolutely stunning, with breathtaking views of the pool and beach. We can't wait to return!" – Sandra⭐"We absolutely loved the location! Everything was within walking distance, and the lagoon pool was simply gorgeous." – Rebecca⭐"Our family had an unforgettable trip. The condo was spotless, beautifully updated, and perfectly located near shops and restaurants." – Jack*** LIVING AREA ***Indulge in modern coastal elegance with open, light-filled living spaces crafted for ultimate relaxation. The living room invites you to sink into luxurious plush seating, enjoy entertainment on the flat-screen TV, or step through the sliding doors onto a private balcony. From there, take in breathtaking views of the sparkling lagoon-like pool—your perfect retreat after a sun-soaked day at the beach!Spacious Open Concept Design with Plenty of Comfortable SeatingSleek Flat-Screen TV Paired with Elegant Coastal-Inspired DecorStunning Pool and Gulf Views from the Main Balcony, Featuring a Dining Table for 4 and Generous Seating Options*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook up a feast or prepare light snacks in the freshly remodeled kitchen. With stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space, this kitchen is both functional and beautiful. Gather around the large dining table to share meals or your latest beach adventures!Stunningly Renovated Kitchen Featuring Modern Stainless Steel AppliancesElegant Dining Table Perfectly Designed to Seat 6 Guests in ComfortInviting Breakfast Bar with Stylish Seating for 3, Ideal for Casual Mornings*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***Sleep in style and comfort! Each bedroom is designed with serene, modern decor, equipped with flat-screen TVs, and plenty of storage to keep your space clutter-free.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.King Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen Beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall access.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***Guests will be treated to an unparalleled experience at High Pointe Resort, where every detail is designed for ultimate enjoyment. Dive into the stunning lagoon-style pool, unwind at Crabby Steve’s Beachfront Bar with breathtaking ocean views, and indulge in world-class amenities that promise to make every moment truly unforgettable.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a Large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this stunning condo blends comfort with unbeatable convenience. Stroll over to the charming streets of Rosemary Beach or Alys Beach to enjoy boutique shopping, fine dining, and breathtaking coastal views. Just steps away, Peddlers Pavilion awaits with live music, delicious ice cream, and a lively atmosphere perfect for making memories.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.This property has 1 included beach set-up available 3/6 to 10/31, featuring 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210112
